scientific_integrity: Prior product-action and incidence-matrix results are explicitly separated from the derived higher-dimensional asymptotic. The new term follows from a transparent first/second Bonferroni calculation, with exact finite replay supplied independently.
scientific_limitations: The exact product-action orbit formulas and the two-dimensional incidence-matrix asymptotic are prior work. Novelty is restricted to the higher-dimensional first collision term and its phase-transition interpretation for the ordered Boolean full-product family; an unindexed prior observation remains possible.
title: Tie-collision phase transition for ordered Boolean full products
